# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farm owner  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza possesses a tall, slender frame characterized by sharp angles rather than curves. She has dark hair with graying strands that she binds tightly in a firm bun at the back, pierced combatively by wire hairpins. Over time, her hair grows silvered while her face retains sharp contours.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015)_

## Personality

Thirza is an unyielding woman of strict morality and limited background, though a slight twitch around her mouth hints at a buried sense of humor. She is extraordinarily tidy, maintaining an agonizing level of cleanliness in her home and yard. Practical and stern, she strongly disapproves of imaginative daydreams, romantic notions, and vanity. Despite her sharp tongue and abrupt manner, she possesses a deep, quiet capacity for affection and devotion, particularly toward her family.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P15](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0015), [v1 c11 P8](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0008), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)_

## Traits

- Strict and moral  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- Obsessively clean and orderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- Pragmatic and anti-romantic  <sub>[v1 c4 P15](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0015), [v1 c11 P8](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0008)</sub>
- Deeply loving beneath a stern exterior  <sub>[v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled homemaker and baker  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c21 P12](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0012)</sub>
- Currant wine making  <sub>[v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Nell into a well-behaved, practical, and educated young woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>
- To maintain order and financial stability at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014)</sub>

## History

Thirza resides at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her quiet brother, Obed Abernethy. When Obed returns from the station with an eleven-year-old orphan girl named Nell Harcourt instead of the boy they intended to adopt for farm labor, Thirza initially insists on sending her back. However, upon witnessing Nell's tragic situation and learning she might be sent to an unkind household, Thirza softens and agrees to keep her. Over the next several years, Thirza works diligently to train Nell in discipline, tidy habits, proper prayer, and homemaking, constantly struggling against Nell's vivid imagination and frequent mishaps. Despite her strictness, Thirza grows deeply attached to Nell, supporting her education through Sunday-school, local classes, and ultimately her entrance into the Regent's Academy. Following the death of Obed from a sudden heart attack after the Abbey Bank failure, Thirza is left devastated and later faces the threat of stone blindness due to severe eye strain. When Thirza considers selling Grey Shutters, Nell forfeits her college scholarship to stay in Brierley as a teacher and care for Thirza, preserving their home together.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c7 P13](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0013), [v1 c8 P8](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0008), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Brierley as the daughter of the original builder of Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Had a youthful romance with John Carrow that ended in a permanent rift after an argument  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
